items.myth: LOR toh koi bhi likh dega
items.fact: Jo aapko jaanta ho, wahi likhe
items.detail: Bade naam se zyada, specific examples matter karte hain.

items.myth: Sab LOR same ho sakte hain
items.detail: Ek padhai, ek project, ek kaam. Alag recommenders, alag strengths.

items.myth: LOR last week mein mangwa lo
items.detail: Pehle se poocho, aur apna resume aur goals unke saath share karo.
